spec.title: DRIFT-NNN — <one-line goal: which promise becomes true>

status.comment: B2 2026-07-24: template in force since Phase A (DRIFT-001..003 written from it); the task's own document marker is the fenced example below

p.UNIT-STABILITY: **Unit-stability check (release precondition):** every anchor cited in §2 has no open obligation in the findings ledger and no `unknown` marker.

p.goal-format: One sentence. What promise, made where, becomes true.

p.CONTRACT-VERBATIM: Verbatim quotes of the governing spec units — never paraphrase:

facts.CONTRACT-LIST-ALL: List every anchor this task realises.
facts.PREMATURE-RETURN: If units disagree, the task is premature — return it to stitching.

p.current-evidence: From campaign verification evidence (do not re-discover):

facts.cs-what-missing: what is missing / broken, with the verification verdict refs.

p.BEHAVIOR-EXHAUSTIVE: Step by step, exhaustively — inputs, outputs, error paths, edge cases. Spell out everything the spec left implied; nothing here may require judgment:

p.behavior-edges: Edge cases: … Error paths (exact error types/codes): …

facts.bd-construction-sites: Sanctioned construction sites to respect (e.g. conform R-001): …
facts.BD-NEVER-EDIT-SPEC: Never edit spec text or golden tests. Spec doubts → §8, not improvisation.

acceptance.title: 6. Acceptance

p.ACCEPTANCE-EXECUTABLE: Executable, complete — the review runs exactly this:

acceptance.fence: cargo test -p <crate> <filter> # new tests listed below must pass bash tools/self-check.sh # floor stays green

facts.acc-cli-scenario: CLI scenario (when applicable): `vibe <…>` → expected output verbatim.
facts.ACC-DISCIPLINE: Discipline: `#[spec(implements = "spec://…#anchor")]` on new items (closes the specmap orphan), `cargo fmt --all`, clippy clean, atomic commits per the repo rules, no AI attribution anywhere.
facts.ACC-UPDATE-MARKERS: On completion update the unit markers: `impl/work → impl/done` (+ next marker per plan, typically `test/plan`), same commit discipline.

p.analogies-format: "Do it like X": `crates/<…>` — the closest existing shape to imitate.

facts.STOP-RULE: If the spec is silent or ambiguous on a point you need: STOP, mark `<!-- REVIEW: <question> -->` at the code point, record the question in the task file under this section, set status `returned`. Do not invent semantics.
facts.BUDGET-SIGNAL: Budget signal: if the change grows past <N> files / <M> lines, stop and return with findings — the task was mis-scoped.

p.log-format: Appended by executor/reviewer: claimed <ts>, returned/review notes, done <ts>.
